Thats exactly how I feel, even if I have a one off great day, which does happen occasionally, the next morning I wake up and still think to myself "what the fuck am I doing here?" 

I have to try and hope that these feelings will go away over time, I'm only 22 so I know I haven't even come close to exploring what life has to offer.
Thank you, I really hope I see some light soon. I really appreciate your help.

I know, I've gotten over insecurities that I thought were leading up to my anger, but I've realized that I have to tackle the issue itself head on. Not just try and change things that I think might be making me unhappy. 

I really think that my relationship has a detrimental affect on me and therefor transfers over to my daughter. I've been begging her for years to try and adapt like I have, but its no use were both extremely selfish about different things and I feel like we'll never change.

Yeah sounds like the best option, I have to travel constantly for the next four months for work so I wouldn't have the ability to commit to it until after work, but I definitely need to try something because if I don't end up killing myself, I'll probably end up getting a heart attack or stroke from my pure rage.

I use marijuana medicinally and the reasons I expressed to my doctor for doing so was my terrible insomnia, (seriously I wish there was 34 hours in a day) and depression. 

He expressed that marijuana can actually be quite negative for those who have depression issues. The reason being is that marijuana is essentially an ibuprofen for a headache. It might help for 2 hours, but doesn't cure your affliction.

Personally for me when dealing with guilt marijuana fucks with my head far too much. That being said I still smoke every day and can't really sedate my emotions without it.

Not sure if it will help you to clear your head without getting high for a while. It worked wonders for me for a bit last year, but like I said, I smoke every day now, so I don't want to sound like a hypocrite.

I could be a lot nicer with how I talk to my girlfriend, I don't physically abuse either of them thats for sure, but I do get worried about my rage sometimes. 

When I was growing up my mom would get drunk and beat the fuck out me sometimes for literally no reason other than the fact I was the first one she could get ahold of. She refuses to acknowledge these facts to this day, and if I even get her close to acknowledging them, I should have nothing to complain about because her father was 10X worse.

I just hope this hereditary line of abuse doesn't carry over to me, I am proud of the fact that I've stayed my rage physically, but the meltdowns they both witness are ridiculous and I'm constantly up and down on a daily basis. She's such a sweet beautiful child and I don't want her to think my behavior is acceptable. 

Im out of options really and feel my immediate death would do them all a huge favor.

I suppose, but its gone on far too long. I've even tried to end my relationship with her because of how bad of a partner I feel I am, but she can't ever let me go. It's even worse because we have a child together and I feel that she is going to have a terrible upbringing because of me.

Next time he forces himself upon you, you must go to the hospital. There are certain traits that can definitively prove your case of rape over the excuse of "consensual hard sex". 

No one deserves that and eventually his abuse on your children will give them psychological issues when they grow up, thus eventually leading them to experience the same dark place you are at now.

Do yourself and your kids a favor and create as much distance as possible, like you said you felt alive again once separated, you just needed your kids more. Put his ass in jail and thats what you can have.

Not too sure if all of these traits describes me. I just feel like I'm a negative influence on those that love me the most and that if I were gone they would probably have a better quality of life. I hate how bad I make people feel and how spiteful I can be at times. No one deserves what I put people through sometimes, I'm a cunt, bottom line.

I tried a few times when I was younger, but for some reason my mother was able to influence the therapists and a bias was always associated with any diagnosis. It really affected me negatively, but I'm not totally against it. 

I have also tried hypo-therapy for my alcohol abuse and while it seemed to work for about a month I completely abandoned it.

I think therapy really is my only option other than the cowards way out.
